annotations.title: Car insurance in Poland: average OC and AC premium (KNF)

description: Use for the average price of car insurance (OC and autocasco) in Poland, its trend and the size of the market. Tell the user that this is a market average and not a quote for one driver. Average car insurance premium in Poland from the quarterly KNF bulletin "Rynek ubezpieczeń" (part D): average gross written premium per policy for OC (motor third-party liability, insurance class 10) and autocasco (AC, class 3) over the last 4 quarters and in the last quarter, change vs a year earlier, policies written and in force, claims paid per 100 PLN of premium in the same window, claims paid per settled claim, the 18 non-life insurance classes, quarterly history and the finwire index finwire_oc_avg_premium. Amounts in PLN. These are market averages: they are not a price quote for a specific driver or car. Informational data, not insurance advice.

history.description: Number of past quarters in the summary, default 8.
